summary: Google DeepMind researchers study visual prompt engineering, showing that automatically modifying task images (e.g., making sketches photorealistic) improves video model reasoning performance more than text prompting or test-time scaling.

practices.reason: Describes a technique of transforming input images before feeding them to video models to boost reasoning performance, but is the lab's own unreplicated result without full methodological detail in the abstract.
practices.quote: an abstract sketch-like scene can be turned into a photorealistic version with a simple call to an image editing model
